name: philippine-demographic-mapper
description: Local-first Philippine choropleth editor with PSGC CSV imports, recovery, and SVG/PNG export.

scripts.check: node tools/check-syntax.mjs && node tools/smoke-test.mjs && npm run data:validate
scripts.boundaries:full: npm run boundaries:barangays && npm run boundaries:detail && npm run boundaries:check
scripts.data:build: node tools/data-pipeline.mjs --psgc tools/fixtures/psgc_sample.csv --boundaries tools/fixtures/boundaries_sample.geojson --out tools/fixtures/generated --report tools/fixtures/psgc_reconciliation_report.md --metadata tools/fixtures/source_metadata.json
scripts.test: npm run check && node tools/validate-samples.mjs && node tools/test-map-labels.mjs && node tools/test-real-map.mjs && node tools/test-workspace-ui.mjs && node tools/test-project-session.mjs && node tools/test-map-navigation.mjs && node tools/test-map-performance.mjs && node tools/test-boundary-detail.mjs && node --test tools/boundary-pipeline.test.mjs tools/read-shapefile.test.mjs tools/fetch-boundary-detail.test.mjs tools/data-output.test.mjs tools/server.test.mjs
